help.headers: Optional. Request HTTP headers as an object: `{ Authorization: 'Bearer ' + token }`.
help.name: Optional. Empty — the name is taken from the URL (or “file”).
help.ttlHours: After how many hours the file is deleted, e.g. `24`. Empty — the default lifetime.
help.maxBytes: Read at most this many bytes of the file. Empty — 1048576 (1 MB).
